notes.title: English translation added and official release
notes.notes:
v 1.1.0
More details
1. Added English translation
2. Added an illustration that can be unlocked by collecting all the endings
3. Swan Topaz exp gauge and level displayed on the title screen
4. Marking the highest/lowest ratings for each ending on the album (except for the true ending series)
5. Sunny in the morning if you have the 'mirror of a saint'. (Existing morale charging function is deleted)

bug fix
1. Fortune teller error fix
2. Fixed a bug where conversations were rarely skipped

other modifications
1. Modified to be strengthened with Swan Topaz where you can see a special ending when 14 endings are achieved (previously 16 times)
2. Increased movement speed during duckling days


As previously announced, we have updated the English translation. We hope that global users will also come in in the future!
If you find a bug, please report it to the forum, and if you find a part that you think is a misinterpretation, capture it and suggest it, and we'll review it. (For Korean users who suddenly see the game in English after the update, please restart after changing the language of the Options menu on the right side of the title screen to 'Korean'.)

In the meantime, we have considered possible parts of the opinions given by users, so I will explain for a moment.
Detailed information of Swan Topaz is displayed on the title screen. It may be difficult to recognize because the notation is too simple, but I think you will understand the meaning as you progress through the game.
It is difficult to include the ability to revisit the ending or the development record, so we have marked the highest/lowest score for each ending, unfortunately. Actually, it was a plan that was deleted while I was thinking of making a score record as an element of digging, but I realized that there were heavy users who value the record.
There are many people who have difficulties with the weather, so the function of the 'mirror of the saint' among the existing items has been changed to adjust the weather. However, it does not work when exploring, and the sun is shining only in the morning on the day of making a schedule.
Feedback that has not been reflected will be a reference for the development of the next work, so please look forward to the next work of Sunflo Labs.

Now, 'Lullaby Days' has completed the early access and has been switched to the official release.
Thanks to bug reports from early access users, many aspects of the game have been improved. Thank you so much for being with us all this time!
We hope that new users will also enjoy the game.
thank you :)

notes.title: The global release of "Lullaby Days" has been postponed.
notes.notes:
『Lullaby Days』 will end early access in early 2022 and switch to full release with English translation.

Since the completeness of the game is already over 99%, it doesn't really matter if you are user for Korean version. However, it seems that many people are waiting for the release of the English version, so I would like to inform.

Initially planned for global launch at the end of this year, translation quality issues arose while English localization work was in progress. Due to the nature of this game, where the scenario is very important, I decided that it would be correct to release it after maximizing the quality of the translation, and decided to postpone the schedule.

Sorry for delaying the schedule. However, as it is delayed, the more complete the English localization work can be expected. 
The store pages and announcements may not be smooth because they mainly use a machine translator, but localization specialist companies are in charge of translating the in-game text of Lullaby Days, also I check again to see if there are any misunderstandings.

Thank you for waiting for the global release of "Lullaby Days".
I look forward to your continued interest.
Thank you.

An event has been added in which a fortune teller appears with a certain probability during the outing and informs the expected future keywords.
Since the prediction is based on the time of meeting the fortune teller, the ending may be different from the prediction due to stat changes or variables that are difficult to predict. Please refer to it and use it appropriately.

The number of items you have is indicated in the 'Item Bag' menu on the main screen. When you have 40 or more, it changes to red text.
If the bag is full, you will not be able to acquire items through exploration or events, but no notification will appear. Actually, it would be right to improve this part, but I ended up with a line indicating the number of items because it was difficult to touch many parts of the game inevitably. There are many types of items that disappear with use, and the bag capacity is quite large, so practically the bag is rarely full. Therefore, I think that most of the inconvenience will be solved just by indicating the number.

notes.title: v 0.2.6 Related to the game being forced to close

We have received reports from some users that the game has been intermittently closed when entering an expedition-battle. Actually, I couldn't find the exact problem, but it was possible that I touched the window mode related part, so I tried to fix that part again.
For those of you who have experienced a forced shutdown, please let us know on the forum if the game works normally with this patch.
We are very sorry for the inconvenience.


2. I'm looking for a solution, and I'm attaching a link that says how to fix the error in case it might be a reference for solving the problem.

https://www.exedb.com/kr/gameassembly.dll/1126095

If you look at the event viewer, it appears that the GameAssembly.dll file causes a problem when it is forced to close, and it is said to be a solution.
My test PCs do not have a forced shutdown problem, so it is difficult for me to check directly. Sorry for not providing a definitive solution, but if the same problem occurs after this patch, we recommend that you try the method in the link above.


3. Please note that there are some people who say that the game works normally if you start the game from the beginning or run the next round after ending the game quickly without a battle.


We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
We'll keep looking for a solution.

notes.title: [v 0.2.0] Battle system balance adjustment
notes.notes:
v 0.2.0

[h3]< Battle system related patches >[/h3]
1. Heal (Holy Magic) card appearance rate increased
2. Increase attack/magic card appearance rate
3. Decrease the appearance rate of Conversation, Escape, and Stealth cards
4. Slight decrease in attack power of some skills (attack, strike, aqua ball, ground wave)

By referring to the opinions of many people, we have increased the proportion of battle cards appearing. (There are also cases where you do not develop an attack type, and you only explore by talking, fleeing, or stealth, so it will be difficult to lower the ratio of auxiliary cards beyond this.)
If the force is higher than the magic power, the probability of getting a physical attack card is slightly higher, and if the magic power is higher, the probability of getting a magic attack card is slightly higher.
However, it is only a matter of probability, so please take into account that if you are unlucky, unwanted cards are bound to appear. If it is a system that only comes out 100% of the cards you want, it will be no different from the system of other RPG games where you simply select a skill from the menu.

If the morale becomes 0 and the daughter becomes 'fear', the system does not show any attack cards at all.
Also, during a martial arts competition, if you are in a 'fear' state, only a dialogue card will appear, and if you press the dialogue at this time, your daughter will surrender. (I'm writing this down because some of you may think you've lost because you don't know this part and just keep talking.) And if you start a conversation when your opponent's will is 0, your opponent will surrender. However, I agree with the opinion that the chat card is not very useful when it is not, so we drastically lowered the appearance rate of the chat card.

As the number of attack cards has increased, we have reduced the attack power of some skills to adjust the balance. This may be further refined in the future.

It seems that the bad reputation will be greatly reduced if the system, which is flexible in action depending on the nature and weather when exploring, is removed, but after much consideration, we have decided to maintain the status quo. (Because it is a system that can be understood once you understand it, and this part may be the biggest characteristic of each attribute..)
Hints about properties and weather can be obtained from Spinel's help or talking to your daughter.
I don't like forced tutorials, so I put all the parts that didn't affect the progress of the game much in the help. Spinel's help is different on the main screen, during exploration, and during egg/duck days, so if you look at each situation once, it will be of some help to the progress of the game. (I have answered several times on the forum bulletin board regarding behavioral skills.)


[h3]< Swantopaz system related patches >[/h3]
We have downgraded the conditions under which Swan Topaz is strengthened.
Therefore, you will be able to see the hero-related endings after the ending of a total of 20 episodes. (previously it was 25 times)

notes.title: Lullaby Days Early Access
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Sunflo Labs.

『Lullaby Days』 has been released in early access.
Lllaby Days made by one person. Since there is a limit for one person to find all the bugs, it was released as early access even almost all development was completed, so please take care :D

If you find any bugs while playing the game, please report them in this forum. If you attach detailed situation information or screenshots when reporting, it will help to find bugs quickly.
Critical bugs will be fixed as quickly as possible, but bugs that do not significantly affect the progress of the game will be collected and dealt with. (My health has deteriorated a lot due to a long development period, so I'm trying to do it a little bit slower, so please understand..)

During the Early Access period, bug fixes, soundtrack update, challenge additions, multilingual support work, etc. will be carried out to sequentially update and deliver related news.

thank you.
